brief:
Israeli forces struck a vehicle in Hamad city, Khan Younis, killing at least one person and wounding several others, Shehab Wire reported. The attack destroyed the vehicle and left casualties at the scene. Video and photographic evidence of the strike circulated among local media outlets.

The strike was one of several Israeli operations across Gaza on the day of reporting. Attacks also struck Beit Lahiya, adding to a pattern of violence in the territory. The incident marked another reported violation of the ceasefire agreement between Israeli forces and Palestinian armed groups, which had been subject to repeated breaches since its implementation.
